active.label: Use: Plant Tree
active.desc: Targets the ground to plant a happy little tree that lasts for 20 seconds.

alchemist.desc:
Alchemist melts down Aghanim's Scepter to grant an allied hero all Aghanim's Scepter upgrades. Alchemist will gain bonus 15 damage and 6 additional base and max Greevil's Greed Extra Gold for each melted Scepter.

BASE BONUS GOLD: 2
MAX BONUS GOLD PER KILL: 16

axe.desc:
Counter Helix now applies a stacking debuff to enemies hit by it that causes them to deal less total attack damage to Axe. Counter Helix no longer has a cooldown and its counter advances when Axe attacks.

DEBUFF DURATION: 6
ATTACK DAMAGE REDUCTION: 12%
MAX STACKS: 5

bristleback.desc: Adds active ability to Bristleback. Bristleback rotates towards the targeted direction and, after 0.5s, forcefully ejects 5 sequential Quill Sprays in a tight conical pattern out of his back every 0.4s. Bristleback's facing is locked during this time, he is disarmed, and his speed is reduced by 40%.

centaur_warrunner.desc:
Centaur hitches a cart behind him. While active, Centaur gains the benefit of Stampede for the current level of Stampede, and can cast Hitch a Ride on a target ally.

TOTAL DURATION: 6

chaos_knight.desc: Gains a passive component. When an illusion of Chaos Knight is created, there is a 50% chance to create an additional illusion under Chaos Knight's control. When Phantasm is activated, also creates an illusion of allied heroes globally.

rattletrap.desc:
Supercharges Clockwerk's abilities:
Battery Assault: Increased radius and affects all enemies in its range.
Power Cogs: Radius increased, and Clockwerk's armor while near Power Cogs is increased.
Rocket Flares: Increased damage, vision and slow duration, and fires additional rockets to either side of the target.
Hookshot: Stun radius and duration increased.
Jetpack: Moves faster.
Clockwerk's movement and attack speed becomes slowed to a crawl after the duration runs out.

DURATION: 18
SELF SLOW DURATION: 3

BATTERY ASSAULT RADIUS: 330

dawnbreaker.desc:
Break of Dawn provides healing amplification equal to the current damage increase.

Solar Guardian's aura follows Dawnbreaker for 2s after landing.

doom_bringer.desc: Doom applies Break to enemies. Allies in a 350 radius around the doomed target also suffer the effects of Doom. Allows Doom to be self-cast to affect enemies around himself with Doom.

dragon_knight.desc: Increases the current level of Dragon Form by one. Adds a Level 4 Black Dragon that has free pathing, bonus magic resistance, and increased other bonuses.

earth_spirit.desc:
Earth Spirit temporarily enchants a hero, granting them the properties of a Stone Remnant. After a short duration the remnant shatters, releasing the hero and damaging nearby enemies. Can be cast on Stone Remnants with a 5s cooldown. Has a larger cast range when cast on an ally hero.

REMNANT DURATION: 2.4
SHATTER DAMAGE: 450
SHATTER RADIUS: 450
CAST RANGE ON ALLIES: 500

earthshaker.desc:
Enchant Totem becomes a ground target ability, causing Earthshaker to jump in the air and land at the target spot, casting Enchant Totem there. Self-casting the ability will behave in the original form, without jumping. Grants Enchant Totem a cleaving attack.

JUMP DISTANCE: 950
CLEAVE DAMAGE: 40%
CLEAVE DISTANCE: 650

elder_titan.desc: Causes Elder Titan to become debuff immune and gain 50% magic resistance for 2 seconds per affected enemy hero when the spirit returns.

kunkka.desc: Ghostship creates a fleet of 2 ships at the target point on a 2.5 second interval. Each ship now also fires 3 waves of cannonballs from the port and starboard side that deal 40% of Ghostship's damage as they pass through enemies.

largo.desc:
Largo can play two songs per beat by strumming both at the same time.

Bullbelly Blitz deals additional magic damage per Groovin' stack when used in double-strumming.

DAMAGE PER STACK: 6/10/14

muerta.desc:
Dead Shot damage is increased. Dead Shot expands after it ricochets and pierces through enemy heroes as it fears them.

Damage: 225/300/375/450

sven.desc: Increases cast range and applies a basic dispel on the target. Affects invulnerable units. If alt-cast, it deals an additional 180 damage and Sven travels with the Storm Hammer.

huskar.desc:
Forces the enemy target to attack Huskar and increases cast range.

Taunt Duration: 3
Cast Range Bonus: 250

juggernaut.desc:
Performs a short Omnislash for 1 seconds.

lifestealer.desc:
Increases cast range and reduces cooldown to 20s. Infest may target enemy heroes for a short duration, attacking them from the inside while increasing Lifestealer's regeneration rate.

Self Max HP Regen: 6%/8%/10%
Enemy Duration: 5

Guardian Angel has global radius, affects buildings, and amplifies health restoration.

Increases Max Mana Burned per Hit.

Causes Assassinate to fire quicker and stun the enemy target.

Provides additional HP Regen, Armor and Status Resistance while in a puddle, trail, or river. Increases puddle/trail radius by 75% and puddle/trail duration by 5s.

BONUS ARMOR: 10
STATUS RESISTANCE: 40%

legion_commander.desc:
Press the Attack: Increases movement speed and becomes a 500 area of effect ability, and always affects Legion Commander when used.
BONUS MOVE SPEED: 25%/28%/31%/34%

Duel: When Legion Commander wins a duel, Press the Attack is automatically triggered around her.

lycan.desc:
Lycan bites an allied hero or creep-hero, granting them Shapeshift properties. Lycan and the bitten target gain 40% Lifesteal and share the healing effect of Lifesteal with each other as long as they are within 1200 range of each other.

COOLDOWN: 110/100/90

mars.desc:
Lowers cooldown by 10s and increases duration. If an enemy is killed in the Arena, Mars and all of his allies inside the Arena restore 35% of their max health and mana and get a 35% attack damage buff for 20s. This effect stacks.

DURATION: 6.5

night_stalker.desc:
Increases bonus movement speed by 15% and attack speed by 50. Killing an enemy hero resets all basic ability cooldowns.

Fireblast: Refined, reducing cooldown by 1s and increasing cast speed by 25%.

Unrefined Fireblast (New Ability): Blasts an enemy unit with a wave of fire, dealing 150 + 1.5x Ogre's Strength in damage and stunning the target. Its mana cost is 35% of Ogre Magi's current mana.

phoenix.desc:
Increases number of attacks to destroy Supernova and allows Phoenix to cast Supernova on an allied hero, bringing both into the sun to be reborn together.

ATTACKS TO DESTROY: 7/10/13
CAST RANGE: 500

primal_beast.desc:
When Primal Beast activates Uproar, he releases 3 waves of 2 projectiles per stack of uproar each in a circle around him. Projectiles deal damage and Break enemies hit. After a short delay, each projectile splinters in two.

DAMAGE: 85
SPLIT DELAY: 1.25

pudge.desc:
Increases Rot radius by 200, damage by 90, and causes it to reduce enemy Health Restoration by 20%.

RADIUS: 450
DAMAGE: 120/150/180/210
HEALTH RESTORATION LOSS: 20%

Greater Bash: Increases knockback. If a knocked-back enemy collides with another enemy, the second enemy is bashed (creeps only receive 25% damage), and the original target takes 25% of Greater Bash's damage again.
KNOCKBACK DISTANCE: 193/202/208/212

Gush becomes a ground targeted wave ability that affects enemy units in a line. Decreases cooldown.

RADIUS: 260
COOLDOWN: 7

tusk.desc:
Kicks the closest enemy unit in the drawn direction, stunning, damaging, and slowing them. Also deals damage to all heroes within 250 radius of its landing area. Cooldown is reduced by 50% if kicking a creep.

Vampiric Spirit: Turns Vampiric Spirit into an aura, allowing allied heroes to turn into wraiths when slain. Extends wraith duration.
WRAITH DURATION: 5.25

Increases initial damage and grants 2 Rupture Charges.

Increases cast range and applies Jinada on hit.

Broodmother may create up to 5 invisible web lines touching any existing web. Enemy Heroes that cross the web line will spring the trap, becoming rooted, revealed in fog, and take damage over time. Summons a row of Burning Skeleton Archers in the target location.

Frost Arrows now apply a Hypothermia stack to enemies, increasing damage from Frost Arrows and reducing their Health Restoration per stack. If an enemy dies with Hypothermia stacks, they burst and deal damage per stack and slow in an area around it.

Entangle applies 5 stacks to enemy heroes in the area and has increased radius. Enemies no longer have protection from gaining stacks while Entangled.

Allows Luna to cast Eclipse on an allied unit or herself and have its effects follow them, or cast it on an area. Increases total beams, reduces duration, removes the limit on beams per unit, and makes the beams appear twice as fast.

Megameepo: Primary Meepo mounts all other Meepos in a 600 radius around him on top of his shoulders. While in this form, he gains 40% of the other Meepo stats and can Fling them at enemies, dealing damage and slowing them. When cast, Earthbind generates additional nets and Poof deals 50% more damage for each Meepo on top.

Causes Sacred Arrow to release a Starstorm on enemies along the travel path of the primary arrow, releasing a second Starstorm that deals less damage to the impacted unit.

PRIMARY HIT STARSTORM DAMAGE: 80%

Spawns a monkey soldier near Monkey King at regular intervals. Soldiers do not spawn while invisible or on trees. Soldiers only attack buildings when Monkey King himself is nearby. Soldiers can now gain Jingu Mastery charges independently.

SOLDIER SPAWN INTERVAL: 4

Adds an alt-cast to Morph. When enabled, a strong illusion is created of the target hero that can cast all of the hero's basic abilities. If the illusion is alive when Morphling toggles the ability, he will take the place of the illusion, destroying it.

ILLUSION INCOMING DAMAGE: 300%

naga_siren.desc:
Ensnare: Increases cast range and projectile speed. Allows Ensnare to target and affect Debuff Immune units. Ensnare applies Break.

Reel In: Allows Reel In to affect Spell Immune units.

Phantom Assassin releases sharp blades around her, dealing a percentage of each victim's max health on impact and applying Break.

MAX HEALTH DAMAGE: 30%
BREAK DURATION: 4

phantom_lancer.desc:
Increases Range. Whenever Phantom Lancer Rushes through enemies, he creates Juxtapose illusions that attack them. Additionally, every 600 units rushed creates a Juxtapose illusion that rushes to the target alongside Phantom Lancer.

MAX RUSH DISTANCE: 1225/1300/1375/1450
COLLISION RADIUS: 125

shadow_fiend.desc:
Reduces cooldown and causes Requiem of Souls to return back to Shadow Fiend. The wave back to Shadow Fiend heals him for all the damage it dealt.

HEAL ON RETURN: 100%

templar_assassin.desc:
Psionic Projection (New Ability): CHANNELED - Allows Templar Assassin to teleport to any Psionic Trap after channeling for 2 seconds, detonating it upon arrival as if it was fully charged and instantly dealing 400 bonus damage. Channeling Psionic Projection does not break Meld.

Increases self multiplier. Upon death, creates a strong illusion of Vengeful Spirit that deals full damage, and can cast all of her spells. Corrosive Skin: Applies 4x the attack speed slow to enemies within 500 distance of Viper. Viper's Corrosive Skin Magic Resistance and Damage per Second are gradually increased while in Nethertoxin, up to 50% increased effect after 4s.

Increases max mana to barrier. Damage that would bring Outworld Destroyer below 20% health is prevented. When that happens, Outworld Destroyer receives a strong dispel and gains an undispellable instance of Objurgation. This effect cannot occur more than once every 80 seconds.

bane.desc: Reduces Fiend's Grip cooldown by 45. Fiend's Grip now creates two uncontrollable illusions that are also channeling Fiend's Grip on the target. Illusions take 225% incoming damage and immediately die if they are interrupted. Damage does not stack.

batrider.desc: Flaming Lasso grabs both its target, as well as the target's nearest allied hero within 650 units. The secondary target is tethered to the first.

beastmaster.desc:
Attacks from Beastmaster or a nearby unit he controls will cause him to bang his drum, dealing damage to nearby units and healing Beastmaster and units under his control for a portion of the damage dealt. Every attack decreases the interval between drum hits down to a minimum of 0.5s between hits after 20 attacks. If no attacks are made, the intervals gradually increase. Using Primal Roar counts as 10 attacks.

DAMAGE RADIUS: 600
ATTACKS FOR SHORTEST INTERVAL: 20
SHORTEST DRUM INTERVAL: 0.5
LONGEST DRUM INTERVAL: 3
DRUM HIT DAMAGE: 80
HEAL FROM HEROES: 20%
HEAL FROM CREEPS: 5%

brewmaster.desc: Primal Split gains 1 max and current level, improving the Brewlings and their abilities. Allows Primal Split to be cancelled early, and causes the Brewlings to be Brewed Up when Primal Split begins.

dazzle.desc: Shadow Wave can now target and bounce between enemies in addition to allies. When bouncing to an enemy, they will take damage and heal nearby allies equal to 100% of the normal healing and damage values. Dazzle will also perform an attack against any enemy that Shadow Wave bounces to.

death_prophet.desc:
Whenever an enemy is affected by Death Prophet's spells or when she attacks an enemy, a ghost will fly out and hit the enemy for an increased bonus of its usual damage then return to her with life.

SPIRIT BONUS DAMAGE: 60%

enigma.desc: Black Hole deals additional damage equivalent to 4% of the unit's Max Health per second and does a non-interrupting pull towards it in a 1000 AoE. Pulls at a rate of 175.

io.desc:
Spirits now passively spawn around Io constantly every second up to the max. Spirits colliding with enemy Heroes slows them briefly. Can be activated to explode spirits.

MOVEMENT SLOW: 25%
SLOW DURATION: 0.3

magnus.desc:
Magnus tosses any enemies in front of him, launching them to his rear. Enemies take damage, spend 0.6 seconds in the air, and are stunned while in the air and an additional amount of time after landing.

DAMAGE: 300
AIR DURATION: 0.6
STUN DURATION: 0.75

marci.desc:
Reduces Unleash cooldown by 10 seconds and causes Unleash to apply a basic dispel on Marci. While Unleash is Active, all of Marci's abilities unleash pulses when cast. All of Marci's unleash pulses will silence units for 1 second.

DISPEL TYPE: Basic Dispel

natures_prophet.desc: Entangles all enemies it hits. Duration scales from 1.5s up to 3s at max bounce.

nyx_assassin.desc:
Nyx Assassin buries himself beneath the battlefield over a short duration. Once burrowed, Spiked Carapace instantly stuns nearby enemies when cast, the range of Mind Flare and Impale is increased, and Impale's cooldown is decreased. While burrowed, Nyx Assassin is stationary, unable to attack, and invisible. Nyx Assassin gains damage reduction from all damage sources.

MAX HP REGEN: 1%
MAX MANA REGEN: 1%
BURROW DAMAGE REDUCTION: 40%
BURROW BONUS CAST RANGE: 500
BURROW BONUS COOLDOWN REDUCTION: 25%
BURROW SPIKED CARAPACE RANGE: 400

pangolier.desc: Causes Shield Crash to cast a 2-attack Swashbuckle every 90 degrees around your hero that deals 75% damage.

sand_king.desc: When the pulses start, 3 Stinger attack areas are created every 0.5s at random locations, each measuring 35% of the Epicenter's current radius, that apply 40% of Stinger damage to enemies hit. Shard pulses cause 1 attack(s).

snapfire.desc:
Gobble Up: Mortimer gobbles up a creep or an allied hero, which he can then spit towards enemies. The unit stays in his belly up to 3 seconds.

Spit Out: Mortimer spits out the unit that's in his mouth, causing impact damage and stun in a large area. The glob leaves a pool of firespit based on the current level of Mortimer Kisses, that slows and applies damage over time. Spit Out has no minimum launch range.
IMPACT RADIUS: 400
STUN DURATION: 1.2

techies.desc:
Plant a warning sign, causing Proximity Mines within its radius to be invulnerable and deal 15% more damage. Only one sign can exist at a time. Lasts 240 seconds. When an enemy Hero walks within 200 units of a minefield sign, the 1000 units area around the sign will become a minefield for 10 seconds, dealing damage to enemy Heroes any time they move within its area. Minefield Sign is destroyed after this effect ends.

EFFECT RADIUS: 1000
SIGN DURATION: 240
DAMAGE: 300
MOVEMENT TRIGGER AMOUNT: 200

venomancer.desc:
Decreases cooldown by 35 seconds. Infected units have decreased magic resistance. Additional spreads from hero targets deal full impact damage.

MAGIC RESIST REDUCTION: 20%

visage.desc:
Increases movement speed, damage, and duration. Turns Visage and familiars invisible for the duration until the flying movement is lost.

FLIGHT DURATION: 30
BONUS MOVESPEED: 24%
BONUS DAMAGE DURATION: 4
BONUS DAMAGE: 20%

void_spirit.desc:
Causes Resonant Pulse to silence and gain 2 charges.

windranger.desc:
Attacks grant Tailwind. Tailwind lasts longer and is undispellable.

Alchemist throws a potion at an ally, applying a basic dispel and giving them attack speed, movement speed and HP regen.

Berserker's Call applies Battle Hunger to affected units.

BATTLE HUNGER

Coughs a quill-packed hairball towards the target location. Erupts at the location, hitting enemies with Viscous Nasal Goo stacks and Quill Spray.

QUILL STACKS: 1
GOO STACKS: 2

Causes Chaos Bolt to create a Phantasm illusion to attack the target. This illusion deals 15% less damage.

Clockwerk activates a jetpack, gaining flying movement, flying vision, and bonus movement speed. Clockwerk has a severely-limited turn rate during this time and cannot attack. Jetpack can be toggled on and off for the duration of the buff.

BONUS SPEED: 20%
DURATION: 6

Devour has 2 charges and can target Ancients. Stolen creep abilities have 20% increased AoE and 40% increased spell amplification.

Ignites an area, dealing damage over time that lingers on enemies in it. Has reduced cast range when melee.

Decreases cooldown to 10s and increases allied unit cast range and pull speed.

ALLIED UNIT PULL SPEED: 900

Reduces Fissure cooldown and releases an Aftershock along its path that stuns for a shortened duration when Earthshaker casts another ability.

Lowers cooldown. Echo Stomp may be alt-cast to allow Elder Titan to take the place of the Astral Spirit as it completes its stomp.

Releases a Tidal Wave that spawns behind Kunkka. Deals damage and drags enemies along it. Enemies cannot attack while being dragged.

largo.desc: Whenever Largo applies a Unit Target buff to a friendly hero, he also gets the buff. If Largo targets himself, the buff is also applied to the nearest allied hero within the cast range of the targeted ability.

muerta.desc: Muerta shoots a spectral bullet at an enemy, dealing 225 damage, knocking them back, and turning them ethereal for 3s — rendering them immune to physical damage and unable to attack. The target is slowed by 30% and takes 20% more magic damage.

Increases radius and bonus movement speed. Warcry is now undispellable and provides a 300 physical damage barrier.

Bonus Speed: 9%/12%/15%/18%
Radius: 900
Physical Barrier Amount: 300

huskar.desc:
Huskar can activate Berserker's Blood for a health cost to cauterize himself. Dispels Huskar, then after a delay, heals for the amount of health consumed plus an additional bonus per debuff dispelled.

Current HP Cost: 30%
Cooldown: 20

juggernaut.desc:
Increases ward healing and health.

Max Health per Second: 3.5%/4.5%/5.5%/6.5%

omniknight.desc: After a 3s delay, the target is Purified again with 65% effectiveness.

Slithereen Crush now applies Corrosive Haze for a short time to units affected.

Overwhelming Odds has larger radius and grants an all damage barrier based on the damage it deals to enemy heroes.

RADIUS: 700

Increases the number of wolves summoned. Grants all summoned wolves the ability Hightail, an active ability that gives them phased movement, evasion, movespeed, and attack speed.

Spear of Mars impales up to 2 heroes and leaves a fire trail behind that deals damage over time and slows movement speed.

Void now affects all units in a radius around the target.

Barathrum gains magic resistance and distorts reality around the selected hero, making any unit-targeted spells cast by enemy heroes get redirected towards Spirit Breaker. Can be cast on both allied and enemy heroes, but only spells cast by enemies of Spirit Breaker will be redirected.

DURATION: 6

Tidehunter attaches a heavy anchor to an enemy hero. The hero is leashed while attached to the anchor. Attempting to move more than 350 units away from the anchor forces the hero to 100 move speed, dragging the anchor behind them. The anchor can be destroyed with 4 hero attacks.

timbersaw.desc:

Units tossed by Toss or trees tossed by Tree Throw or Tree Volley now deal additional damage and slow in a larger area of effect at their landing location.

Treant Protector enchants a tree, which grants him unobstructed vision in that location. The eyes last for 360 seconds and are invisible, but are destroyed if their host tree is destroyed or if they are attacked directly.

BASE CHARGE RESTORE TIME: 135

tusk.desc:
Tusk reaches out to tag an allied unit, pulling them closer. Once tagged, both Tusk and his tagged ally gain movement speed and armor.

BUFF DURATION: 6

Firestorm can be allied targeted. When used that way, the Firestorm follows the hero around. The wave count is increased, and tick rate / duration time occur more quickly.

WAVE COUNT BONUS: 3
DURATION/INTERVAL REDUCTION: 25%

wraith_king.desc: Mortal Strike hits curse their target, causing them to take 75% of the initial attack damage again as Pure damage after a 3 second delay. Vampiric Spirit's lifesteal applies to the curse damage.

bloodseeker.desc: Bloodseeker's Bloodrage attacks now deal 1.5% of the target's max health as Pure damage.

bounty_hunter.desc: Applies Shadow Walk and all of its bonuses to the target ally. Allied fade time is 0.5s. Does not break Bounty Hunter's invisibility when cast.

broodmother.desc: While Hunger is active, the bonus damage is increased by 4% every 1s.

clinkz.desc:
CHANNELED - Clinkz channels and shoots multiple piercing arrows in the target direction that hit all enemy units dealing a percentage of Clinkz' attack damage and applying attack modifiers.

ARROWS FIRED: 6
RANGE: 850
DAMAGE PER ARROW: 75%

drow_ranger.desc:
Drow creates a hill of ice beneath her, knocking away nearby enemies. Units on the hill gain flying vision and Drow and her ranged allies gain bonus attack range. Drow gains additional damage while on the Glacier and attacking targets below her. The front of the hill obscures vision and cannot be moved through except by Drow. Does not interrupt Multishot when cast.

DURATION: 8
ATTACK RANGE BONUS: 200
HIGH GROUND DAMAGE BONUS: 25%

Immolation: Grants Fire Remnants the current level of Immolation, and increases the damage per second and radius.
RADIUS: 350
DAMAGE PER SECOND: 21

Fire Remnant: If an enemy hero dies near Ember Spirit, a Fire Remnant charge will be replenished.
CHARGE RADIUS: 400

faceless_void.desc:
Increases slow per stack. Provides Faceless Void with stacks that increase his attack and movement speed. Amount of stacks is equal to the total amount of Time Dilation stacks applied to enemies at the moment of the cast and linearly fades out over the duration.

MOVEMENT SLOW PER STACK: 9%/10%/11%/12%
ATTACK SLOW PER STACK: 9/10/11/12

hoodwink.desc:
Tosses a boomerang in an arc. Upon contact, it returns to Hoodwink. The boomerang will deal damage as it passes through or hits enemies, and apply a debuff that causes affected enemies to be slowed and be more vulnerable to spell damage.

RADIUS: 150

DISPEL TYPE: Basic Dispel
DURATION: 3

mirana.desc:
Leap: Grants +1 Leap charge.

Celestial Quiver: Grants 3 temporary Charges while Leap's buff is active.

Both Attribute Shift abilities: Morphling can shift attributes while stunned. Reduces mana cost.

Allies in range of Song of the Siren recover a percentage of their health and mana per second.

MAX MANA REGEN PER SECOND: 4%

vengeful_spirit.desc: Bounces once on an enemy, prioritizing heroes, within 75% of Magic Missile's current cast range from the first target.

DURATION: 10

Ringmaster shines 3 spotlights that sweep over an area. Enemies in the light have a chance to miss their attacks and are revealed if invisible. lich.desc: Sinister Gaze becomes an Area of Effect ability, affecting units within a radius of 400 in the target area. Sinister Gaze allows Lich to cast other abilities while channeling it.

lina.desc:
Grants Lina unobstructed movement and increases her spell damage and magic resistance. Grants max fiery soul stacks on activation.

DURATION: 7
MAGIC RESISTANCE: 35%
SPELL AMP: 35%

lion.desc:
Finger of Death gains area of effect damage on the initial cast, and increases duration and cleave damage on its subsequent melee attacks.

DAMAGE: 700/825/950
MELEE DURATION: 30
CLEAVE DAMAGE: 50%
AREA OF EFFECT: 325

necrophos.desc: Heartstopper Aura's Health Decay is increased by 50% of Necrophos's current health regeneration.

oracle.desc:
Oracle pulls a random Tarot Card now and every 90 seconds to receive its buff for 90 seconds. Oracle always knows the next Tarot Card.

Death: 40% Spell Amplification
The Fool: 100% Increased Gold Gain
The World: 150% Increased Intelligence
The Lovers: 40% Heal Amplification
The Tower: 400 All Damage Barrier (regenerates after not taking damage for 7s)

outworld_destroyer.desc:
Increases max mana to barrier. Damage that would bring Outworld Destroyer below 20% health is prevented. When that happens, Outworld Destroyer receives a strong dispel and gains an undispellable instance of Objurgation. This effect cannot occur more than once every 80 seconds.

MAX MANA BARRIER: 16%

puck.desc: All enemies affected by Dream Coil are attacked at a rate equal to 90% of Puck's attack rate. The attacks continue while the target is stunned if they break the Dream Coil.

pugna.desc: Reduces cooldown by 3.5s. When targeting an enemy hero, Pugna reduces their outgoing spell damage by 8% per second up to a maximum of 75% and increases his own, up to a maximum of 100%. When draining through a Nether Ward using Shard, the rate of increase/decrease is 4% instead. Debuff lasts 8 seconds.

queen_of_pain.desc: Causes Shadow Strike to become a 375 AoE Spell. When Shadow Strike ends or is re-applied to an enemy Hero, the target emits a Scream of Pain, hitting any nearby enemies.

ringmaster.desc:
Escape Act has 2 charges. When the box pops open, Impalement Art daggers are thrown in all directions, and all enemies around it take damage.

EXPLOSION RADIUS: 225
EXPLOSION DAMAGE: 300

rubick.desc:
Increases the number of spells that can be stolen to 2. Increases cast range, and upgrades stolen spells to their Scepter version.

CAST RANGE: 1400

shadow_demon.desc:
Causes Demonic Purge to break and gain 2 charges.

BASE CHARGE RESTORE TIME: 70/65/60

shadow_shaman.desc:
Increase cast range. Every 0.9 seconds, shackled units emit a radial Ether Shock hitting all other units within 600 of the target for 100% of Ether Shock's normal damage. Shackles can now also be cast on allies and Mass Serpent Wards that stay within 2000 units of Shadow Shaman. Allied units are not disabled by Shackle.

CAST RANGE: 600

silencer.desc: Global Silence applies Arcane Curse to heroes for the duration of Global Silence.

skywrath_mage.ability: Concussive Shot / Ancient Seal / Mystic Flare
skywrath_mage.desc:
Concussive Shot: When Skywrath Mage casts Concussive Shot, a different random target within 500 range of the original target will be hit with the same ability. Heroes will take priority.

Ancient Seal: Anytime Skywrath Mage casts Ancient Seal, a different random target within 500 range of the original target will be affected by the same ability. Heroes will take priority.

Mystic Flare: When Skywrath Mage casts Mystic Flare, another Mystic Flare will be created on the position of a different random target enemy within 500 range of the original target. Heroes will take priority.

storm_spirit.desc:
Electric Vortex affects all enemies within a radius around Storm Spirit.

RADIUS: 475

tinker.ability: Laser / March of the Machines / Deploy Turrets
tinker.desc:
Laser: Upgrades Tinker's Laser into a Shrink Ray, reducing the main target's size, current health, and maximum health by 13% (stacking). Does not pierce debuff immunity.

March of the Machines: March of the Machines applies a non-stacking heal over time when passing through allied heroes.
HEAL PER SECOND: 35
HEAL DURATION: 4

Deploy Turrets: Turrets fire missiles 20% faster.
ATTACK INTERVAL: 1.2

winter_wyvern.desc:
Causes Arctic Burn to be a toggle ability, draining mana every second when active. Increases Winter Wyvern's movement speed.

MANA PER SECOND: 20
MOVEMENT SPEED: 25%

witch_doctor.desc:
Death Ward attacks bounce between nearby enemies.

BOUNCE RADIUS: 575

zeus.desc:
Creates a storm cloud anywhere on the map that automatically casts Lightning Bolt on nearby enemies.

DURATION: 30

RADIUS: 450

CREEP HITS TO DESTROY: 16

abaddon.desc:
Increases duration. While Borrowed Time is active, anytime an ally takes more than 550 damage while within Mist Coil's cast range of Abaddon, an individual Mist Coil will automatically fire towards that ally.

DURATION: 7/8/9
DAMAGE THRESHOLD: 550

arc_warden.desc:
Flux silences when the target is alone, deals more damage, and lasts longer.

DURATION: 8

bane.desc: Reduces Fiend's Grip cooldown by 45. Fiend's Grip now creates two uncontrollable illusions that are also channeling Fiend's Grip on the target. Illusions take 225% incoming damage and immediately die if they are interrupted. Damage does not stack.

batrider.desc: Flaming Lasso grabs both its target, as well as the target's nearest allied hero within 650 units. The secondary target is tethered to the first.

beastmaster.desc:
Attacks from Beastmaster or a nearby unit he controls will cause him to bang his drum, dealing damage to nearby units and healing Beastmaster and units under his control for a portion of the damage dealt. Every attack decreases the interval between drum hits down to a minimum of 0.5s between hits after 20 attacks. If no attacks are made, the intervals gradually increase. Using Primal Roar counts as 10 attacks.

DAMAGE RADIUS: 600
ATTACKS FOR SHORTEST INTERVAL: 20

LONGEST DRUM INTERVAL: 3
DRUM HIT DAMAGE: 80
HEAL FROM HEROES: 20%
HEAL FROM CREEPS: 5%

brewmaster.desc: Primal Split gains 1 max and current level, improving the Brewlings and their abilities. Allows Primal Split to be cancelled early, and causes the Brewlings to be Brewed Up when Primal Split begins.

dazzle.desc: Shadow Wave can now target and bounce between enemies in addition to allies. When bouncing to an enemy, they will take damage and heal nearby allies equal to 100% of the normal healing and damage values. Dazzle will also perform an attack against any enemy that Shadow Wave bounces to.

death_prophet.desc:
Whenever an enemy is affected by Death Prophet's spells or when she attacks an enemy, a ghost will fly out and hit the enemy for an increased bonus of its usual damage then return to her with life.

SPIRIT BONUS DAMAGE: 60%

enigma.desc: Black Hole deals additional damage equivalent to 4% of the unit's Max Health per second and does a non-interrupting pull towards it in a 1000 AoE. Pulls at a rate of 175.

io.desc:
Spirits now passively spawn around Io constantly every second up to the max. Spirits colliding with enemy Heroes slows them briefly. Can be activated to explode spirits.

MOVEMENT SLOW: 25%
SLOW DURATION: 0.3

magnus.desc:
Magnus tosses any enemies in front of him, launching them to his rear. Enemies take damage, spend 0.6 seconds in the air, and are stunned while in the air and an additional amount of time after landing.

DAMAGE: 300
AIR DURATION: 0.6
STUN DURATION: 0.75

marci.desc:
Reduces Unleash cooldown by 10 seconds and causes Unleash to apply a basic dispel on Marci. While Unleash is Active, all of Marci's abilities unleash pulses when cast. All of Marci's unleash pulses will silence units for 1 second.

DISPEL TYPE: Basic Dispel

natures_prophet.desc: Entangles all enemies it hits. Duration scales from 1.5s up to 3s at max bounce.

nyx_assassin.desc:
Nyx Assassin buries himself beneath the battlefield over a short duration. Once burrowed, Spiked Carapace instantly stuns nearby enemies when cast, the range of Mind Flare and Impale is increased, and Impale's cooldown is decreased. While burrowed, Nyx Assassin is stationary, unable to attack, and invisible. Nyx Assassin gains damage reduction from all damage sources.

MAX HP REGEN: 1%

BURROW DAMAGE REDUCTION: 40%
BURROW BONUS CAST RANGE: 500
BURROW BONUS COOLDOWN REDUCTION: 25%
BURROW SPIKED CARAPACE RANGE: 400

pangolier.desc: Causes Shield Crash to cast a 2-attack Swashbuckle every 90 degrees around your hero that deals 75% damage.

sand_king.desc: When the pulses start, 3 Stinger attack areas are created every 0.5s at random locations, each measuring 35% of the Epicenter's current radius, that apply 40% of Stinger damage to enemies hit. Shard pulses cause 1 attack(s).

snapfire.desc:
Gobble Up: Mortimer gobbles up a creep or an allied hero, which he can then spit towards enemies. The unit stays in his belly up to 3 seconds.

Spit Out: Mortimer spits out the unit that's in his mouth, causing impact damage and stun in a large area. The glob leaves a pool of firespit based on the current level of Mortimer Kisses, that slows and applies damage over time. Spit Out has no minimum launch range.
IMPACT RADIUS: 400
STUN DURATION: 1.2

Plant a warning sign, causing Proximity Mines within its radius to be invulnerable and deal 15% more damage. Only one sign can exist at a time. Lasts 240 seconds. When an enemy Hero walks within 200 units of a minefield sign, the 1000 units area around the sign will become a minefield for 10 seconds, dealing damage to enemy Heroes any time they move within its area. Minefield Sign is destroyed after this effect ends.

EFFECT RADIUS: 1000
SIGN DURATION: 240
DAMAGE: 300
MOVEMENT TRIGGER AMOUNT: 200

venomancer.desc:
Decreases cooldown by 35 seconds. Infected units have decreased magic resistance. Additional spreads from hero targets deal full impact damage.

MAGIC RESIST REDUCTION: 20%

visage.desc:
Increases movement speed, damage, and duration. Turns Visage and familiars invisible for the duration until the flying movement is lost.

FLIGHT DURATION: 30
BONUS MOVESPEED: 24%
BONUS DAMAGE DURATION: 4
BONUS DAMAGE: 20%

void_spirit.desc:
Causes Resonant Pulse to silence and gain 2 charges.

BASE CHARGE RESTORE TIME: 18

windranger.desc:
Attacks grant Tailwind. Tailwind lasts longer and is undispellable.
